# Download-only flatmap validation data

The files listed in `manifest.csv` are not bundled in the installed package.
They are downloaded only for checksum-pinned integration validation and
tutorial-figure reproduction.

The S1200 Conte69 flat and midthickness surfaces and atlas-ROI masks are HCP
Open Access data mirrored by the MNI BIC. Their use remains subject to the
WU-Minn HCP Open Access Data Use Terms and acknowledgement requirements.

The Schaefer 2018 Conte69 label files are fetched from the immutable micapipe
commit recorded in the manifest. The upstream repository is GPL-3.0 and the
atlas should be cited as Schaefer et al. (2018), *Cerebral Cortex*,
28(9):3095-3114.

The rendered tutorial figures are validation outputs, not redistributed
surface, metric, or label files. They acknowledge HCP and the Schaefer atlas
in the accompanying tutorial text.
